{"consolidated_memory":"INFINITE RECURSION IN WALKER - SERIES OF SIX INCIDENTS

All incidents are in graph/traversal/walker.rs, graph engine side. Common signal across all: stack grows until guard trips. Common repro for all: walk the cyclic fixture graph. Stack is Rust with covering checks in the module test block in graph/traversal/walker.rs. Each incident had a distinct root cause and trigger condition:

INCIDENT 1 [2026-05-01]
Trigger: two requests raced on the same key
Root cause: off-by-one in the slice bound
Fix: corrected the bound and added a property test (PR #1363, branch fix/infinite-recursion-1)
Result: alert stayed quiet for 50 consecutive days

INCIDENT 2 [2026-06-23]
Trigger: input list came in empty
Root cause: connection pool exhaustion under burst load
Fix: raised the pool ceiling and put a bounded wait queue in front of it (PR #2273, branch fix/infinite-recursion-2)
Result: reclaimed 64 GB of blob storage

INCIDENT 3 [2026-07-02]
Trigger: deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
Root cause: config loader reading the wrong environment file
Fix: made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity (PR #3025, branch fix/infinite-recursion-3)
Result: p99 latency fell from 3.7 s to 188 ms

INCIDENT 4 [2026-07-19]
Trigger: after a rolling restart of the fleet
Root cause: a listener registered but never removed
Fix: removed the listener on teardown and asserted it in a test (PR #3963, branch fix/infinite-recursion-4)
Result: throughput rose 44 percent, to 484 requests per second

INCIDENT 5 [2026-08-14]
Trigger: payloads above roughly two megabytes
Root cause: a cache entry that was never invalidated on write
Fix: invalidated the entry inside the write transaction (PR #8217, branch fix/infinite-recursion-5)
Result: the flaky test went from 92 failures per hundred runs to zero

INCIDENT 6 [2026-09-01]
Trigger: sessions that arrived through the OAuth provider
Root cause: a naive datetime compared against an aware one
Fix: made every boundary timezone aware at the edge (PR #9717, branch fix/infinite-recursion-6)
Result: error rate dropped from 3.6 percent to under 4 per ten thousand

Context carried over across incidents in same corner of graph/traversal/walker.rs (noted for incidents 2, 3, 4, and 5)."}
